name: SA-HELP
summary: A loan that pays your student services and amenities fee, so you don't pay it upfront.
key: The fee is capped at $373 for full-time students in 2026.
need: A tax file number, or proof you have applied for one.
A valid SA-HELP form, submitted to your provider by the fee due date.
how: Submit the SA-HELP form through your provider by the fee due date.
You apply once per course. Changing course or provider needs a new form.
catches: It is added to your HELP debt and indexed each 1 June.
It doesn't count toward your HELP borrowing limit.
